title: A phone that ran out of memory comes back at lower detail
items: If the walk closed while loading last time, as a phone does when it runs out of memory, the next visit starts one Scene detail level lower at Sharpness Low, and a card says so. Settings can raise either again.
When the display is lost, the page reloads at most once. If it is lost again, the card offers a Reload at a lower detail level, so a phone no longer gets stuck reloading.
